name: Katsuragi Ria
source:
Ria is [url=/c17131]Masato[/url]'s younger sister and a childhood friend of [url=/c17125]Hisui[/url], her "Hime-oneechan". She left the city with her brother and parents a few years ago but has recently returned to join the high school run by Sleipnir, a military branch specializing in AD technologies.

Since her integration in first year, Ria quickly became one of the best students, her AD armor being very famous for its impenetrable defense.
